name: Proximal Operator for STP Regularizer (Dual Projection)
definition: The proximal operator for the convex conjugate $g^*(H)$ of the STP regularizer. It corresponds to the projection of a matrix $H$ onto the convex set $\lambda B_{\infty, q}$, which is the unit ball of the dual $(\infty, q)$ norm scaled by $\lambda$.
